savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: All policies and standards implemented by the Interagency Security Committee that was established pursuant to Executive Order 12977 shall remain in effect until rescinded or replaced by the Committee established pursuant to this order.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.reaches: policies and standards issued under EO 12977
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Keeps the Interagency Security Committee's policies and standards in effect until rescinded or replaced by the Committee established by EO 14111: a continuation of the products of the revoked order and of its Committee's role.

transfer_provisions.quote: Section 1. Establishment. There is hereby established the Interagency Security Committee (Committee).
transfer_provisions.note: Re-establishes the Committee, chaired by the Secretary of Homeland Security, with the same security policy and standards duties (sec. 5): the function is carried forward.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 7 has no effective-date or delayed-effect wording ('This order supersedes Executive Order 12977 ..., which is hereby revoked'); the revocation took effect on signing, 2023-11-27 (printed 88 FR 83811, December 1, 2023). The '1 year after the date of this order' in sec. 5(d) is a reporting deadline, not an effective date, so the dossier's 2024-11-27 'relative' date is not an effective date of the revocation.

targets_in_batch_08.EO:12977: sec. 7 ('This order supersedes Executive Order 12977 of October 19, 1995 (Interagency Security Committee), which is hereby revoked'): whole order, no qualifier; the last sentence of sec. 7 keeps the old Committee's policies and standards in effect until rescinded or replaced.

conclusion: EO 14111 (signed 2023-11-27, 88 FR 83809-83812, read once in full) re-establishes the Interagency Security Committee (secs. 1-6), supersedes and revokes EO 12977 and keeps the old Committee's policies and standards in effect until rescinded or replaced (sec. 7), defines terms (sec. 8) and has general provisions (sec. 9). The revocation is unqualified and effective on signing; the continuation clause covers the products of the old Committee, not provisions of EO 12977.
